research_question: Can single-segment-query Chebyshev representations remove the AST-P2-041 segment-boundary speed discontinuity without widening the existing five-body accuracy, artifact-size, or query-payload gates?

coverage.source_grid_validation: all available 5-day source samples inside the declared validation window
coverage.segment_padding: source collection may extend only enough to complete the final segment and declared overlap-training window; output coverage remains the declared validation window

representation_family.longitude_preprocess: local unwrap with 360-degree branch alignment where continuity constraints require it
representation_family.speed: analytic derivative of the fitted Chebyshev polynomial
representation_family.segment_selection: deterministic floor from coverage start; one stored segment per ordinary query

variants.mechanism: overlap-trained ordinary least squares with hard core-segment switch
overlap-trained ordinary least squares with hard core-segment switch

rules: Do not widen thresholds or change candidate degree/width/padding after observing results.
A variant passes only if every frozen gate passes.
Use direct Horizons truth at the existing 12 E2 validation instants; derive fixture truth speed by the existing ±1 hour central-difference contract.
Use the complete in-window 5-day source grid as an additional longitude-only anti-drift validation surface.
C1 variants must preserve a one-segment runtime lookup; continuity is encoded in coefficients, not runtime two-segment blending.
Overlap-trained variants may use neighboring source samples at build time but ordinary runtime still selects exactly one core segment.
No production mutation or provider admission follows automatically from feasibility.
If every declared variant fails, the result rejects only this declared continuity/overlap candidate family; bounded SPK and other architectures remain separate research.
